BPSSC Bihar Police Havildar Instructor 2026 Exam Postponed - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Police Subordinate Service Commission (BPSSC) has released the admit card for the post of Havildar Instructor. This recruitment was released for 122 posts. Applications for the BPSSC Bihar Police BPSSC Havildar Instructor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 09 May 2026 to 09 June 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 05 August 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Bihar Police BPSSC Havildar Instructor Admit Card 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 May 2026
  • Last Date : 09 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 09 June 2026
  • Rejection List : 17 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 05 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 21 July 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
